I wonder whether, therefore, when you, on purpose, referred to aiding for criminal intent or intention or whether, under Yugoslav law, knowledge is sufficient?

utterances.speaker: ZIVOJIN ALEKSIC
utterances.text: In this expert opinion, which I had the liberty to provide to you, I wrote down that when it comes to aiding, it can defined as the intentional provision of assistance to the perpetrator in the commission of the act that was actually committed. In elaborating this premise, I wrote that the act of the aider must be the contribution to the commission of the act, they must have an effect on the commission of the act committed by the perpetrator and have an effect on the commission. This does not mean, I'm quoting from my own report, that in addition to the acts of aiding, which had a causal relationship to the commission of the crime, in accordance with the formula condictio sine qua non, that it means that the act would not be realised or committed. It is too much to require of an aider to increase the chances. We are looking for the efficient support of the perpetrator and the creation of favourable conditions. I gave you an example where I go to see my friend. I take him out for a walk, and I allow my other friend to burgle his place. I don't know if that's enough.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you. I think we are short on time, so I will refrain from asking you a third question which, in any case, was rather minor. I wonder whether there are any other questions? There's no objection to our witness being released. Thank you, Professor, for coming here to give evidence in court. You may now be released. Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. (The witness withdrew)

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: We will now move to the Prosecution witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, at this time, we would call Vladimir Dzuro.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you. And we were given his witness statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, we provided the report that he completed. It's not actually in the form of a statement but it is a signed report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: While we're waiting, Your Honours, would it be possible for the Prosecutor to give me photographs which at least allow us to see something and not just black marks? Do you have photographs in colour, by any chance?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, yes, we will be providing photographs during the course of his testimony. If you would like them in advance, we can provide that.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, if possible. I apologise, but it is really impossible for me to follow. The quality is really horrible.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: I agree with you, Mr. Fila. I also had the same problem, but probably if the Prosecutor could be so kind as to provide us with colour photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well, Your Honour. Would you, as well, like coloured photographs now or do you want it to be done as we go through the testimony?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: As we go through the testimony, all right, if it is fine with Mr. Fila.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No, it would be better for me to receive them right now so that I am able to follow. It really would be better.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: At least for Mr. Fila, it is important, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well, Your Honour. We were just trying to do it in a manner where we could keep them straight and so that they would be organised, because the photographs are very, very similar. But we will certainly provide copies to Mr. Fila.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Your Honours, these are the photographs that you gave to me. So I would just like to have coloured photographs of those same photographs. I think that Mr. Dzuro took those photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, we will provide him copies of everything that will be submitted during the course of Mr. Dzuro's testimony.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: This may take us just a moment to go through and organise this but we will. (The witness entered court)

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you. Good afternoon. Could you please make the solemn declaration?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I solemnly declare that I will speak the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you. You may be seated. These photographs, I mean, they also relate to the report of expert witness Tabbush, the same photographs, I think?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, there are -- some of the photographs were used by Mr. Tabbush as well. Most of them will come in through Mr. Dzuro and will already have a reference number by the time Mr. Tabbush testifies. But there may possibly be some additional photographs at that time that we would introduce.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Tabbush will be tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct, Your Honour. We have almost completed this process with the photographs.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Examined by Mr. Williamson:

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, where are you currently employed?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I work for the Office of the Prosecutor of the International War Crimes Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is your job assignment within the Office of the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I work as an investigator.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How long have you been affiliated with the Office of the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I started to work for the Office of the Prosecutor in April 1995.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Prior to coming to the Tribunal, where were you employed?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Since 1993, I worked for the Czech Police Force as a policeman, then as an investigator. And then further I was assigned as a senior special agent at INTERPOL, National Central Bureau of INTERPOL, Prague.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you also have opportunity to work in the former Yugoslavia for some period when you were still affiliated with the Czech Police?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. Since February 1994 until March 1995, I worked as a senior secretary officer as the chief of the field secretary office in Sarajevo in Bosnia.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, at this time I'm going to show you a document which I'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 214, I believe, and I would like for you to look at this.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: If a pause could please be made between question and answer?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you hear that, Mr. Dzuro?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is this a report that you prepared in connection with an investigation that you've conducted in relation to the alibi videotape which is marked as Defence Exhibit 2?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would tender this report now as Prosecutor's Exhibit 214.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Any objection, Mr. Fila?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, since coming to the Tribunal, have you been involved in the investigation of war crimes which occurred in the Vukovar region of Croatia?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. Since the first time I arrived to the Tribunal and was assigned as an investigator, I worked almost exclusively on the crimes committed in the Vukovar area.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In that capacity, did you participate in an interview of Mr. Dokmanovic which took place at Scheveningen prison on the 26th and 27th of November of last year?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's right. I did, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At this interview, did you become aware in general terms of the alibi defence that Mr. Dokmanovic was going to present?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: During the course of that interview, did you also become aware of a videotape which the Defence intended to use in support of its alibi?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I think it was on the 26th when, for the first time, I heard about the tape, and Mr. Dokmanovic and Mr. Fila were saying that it would be possible to view it at some stage. And we agreed that on the 27th, the next day, we would bring the VCR and television, because there was no TV in the prison that was available for us. So we brought the television there. But in the end, we didn't have a chance to view the tape because Mr. Dokmanovic and Mr. Fila decided otherwise.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you subsequently have an opportunity to view the videotape?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Will you please make an actual pause before the answer, please?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: We have the converse this time.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I'm sorry for that.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: My apologies to Mr. Fila. We know how it feels on the other side. Sorry about that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When you did have an opportunity to view this videotape, did you recognise the locations which were depicted in it?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, in general terms, yes. Sorry, in general terms, yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In the three years that you've been affiliated with the Office of the Prosecutor, have you had occasion to familiarise yourself with the Vukovar area?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, since August 1996, I was travelling to Vukovar on a regular basis. Since 1996 in August, I arrived for the first time in Vukovar, and the reason why I travelled there was that I participated in exhumations of the mass grave at Ovcara. And then since that time on, I was travelling to Vukovar, as I say, on a regular basis to interview the witnesses there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, the court reporter has also asked if you can slow down a little bit.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I'll try.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So would it be fair to say that you know the Vukovar area quite well?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yeah, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, after the videotape was received by the Prosecution and initially viewed, were you assigned to further investigate what was depicted on the tape?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I was asked by the Prosecutor to make further examination to the tape.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What exactly did you set out to do in this regard?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: First, I studied the map of the Vukovar region and the city plan of Vukovar and tried to locate the route that Mr. Dokmanovic and the group with him took on the 20th of November. Then I went to this TV unit at the ICTY and, together with my colleague, I printed a number of stills off of this video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I assume, Mr. Dzuro, that the stills were printed at the time before the video unit ran out of copying paper to do this?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I have to admit that I actually caused the problem with that because there was a large number of the prints we made, and they didn't have a supply of the paper. So I probably have to apologise to the court.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At this time, I would like to show you a photograph and, if you can, please identify this.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I will mark this first photograph as Prosecutor's Exhibit 215.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, do you recognise this photograph?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's one of the video stills, the stills I took from the Defence video, and it actually shows the scene at 15.36 when the car is leaving Vukovar. You can see the tree which is very -- is important on the picture, because as a hole, in the top part of the tree, you can see also the electric post on the right side of the road. And then it's almost invisible, but there are two white posts which I will refer to in my future testimony. That's why I took this still because it shows the end of Vukovar.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would like you to take a look at the next photograph which is marked as Prosecutor's Exhibit 216.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Your Honours, I obviously received all those photographs, but it would be nice if Mr. Williamson could just lift the relevant photograph up so that we can see which photograph we are talking about, or to use the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I think it would be -- I understand Mr. Fila's suggestion. I think perhaps it would be better to display them on the ELMO and then it's clear what we're talking about.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Perhaps, Mr. Dzuro, if we can go back for just a moment to the first photograph, 215, and if you can point out on here the characteristics that you just described?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I was talking about a tree which is on the right side of the road if you head from Vukovar south towards Negoslavci, and in particular, about the top part of the tree with the hole in the middle, and also the electric post here in the field and you can see here the two white posts (indicated).

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, if you would, look at the next photograph which we'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 216, and if you could indicate what this is?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This photograph is a little bit further down the road. We passed all of the trees on the right side, but here you can see more clearly these two white posts.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Very well --

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: And these pole lines -- I mean, the electric posts on the right side and on the left side.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At this time, I would like for you to view the next photograph which we'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 217, and again, if you can display this on the ELMO, please, and explain what is depicted in this picture?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is an image that was depicted at 15.42 on the Defence video. You can see the roof of the building with a big gable facing the road. There is a window on the upper part and then you've got a bus which is in between the gentleman who made the film and the building. You can also see the trees which are directly in front of the house, with the branches.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At this time, I would like for you to look at the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 218. In relation to this photograph, Mr. Dzuro, I have provided you also with a copy of this, as has been provided to everyone else. Do you know where the original of this is?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The original of the still I gave to Mr. Tabbush because he used it for his analysis, for his expertise, and I believe it is still in his possession.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you explain to the court what is depicted in this photograph at 218?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This photograph is very similar to the previous one, again with a roof, the window, and the bus travelling from in between the cameraman and the building. Again, the tree, different angle, slightly different angle with the branches.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would like for you to look at the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 219, and if you can explain what is depicted in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The photograph, as you can see, it is almost the same as the previous one, but importantly it is in black and white because we were asked by Mr. Tabbush to produce the photograph in black and white because it shows better the branches of the tree.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would like for you now to look at the next photograph which we'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 220.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is one of the first stills I took from -- the first set of stills I took from the video. You can see that it's very hazy, and it shows the building which, on a previous photograph, we just saw the roof of that. Here we can see more of that building with the boarded windows on the upper part and then the tree, the branches, and again the bus passing in between the cameraman and the building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Again, in relation to photographs 219 and 220, just as 218, I have only provided copies to you, so is the situation the same with these two exhibits that Mr. Tabbush also has the originals?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct, Mr. Tabbush has the original of this still.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At this time, I would show you the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 221. Can you explain what is depicted in this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Again, this is the house, what I was referring to before, with the mid-roof gable facing the road with the windows, the tree -- with the window and tree branches and the bus. The difference between the previous one and this one is that we tried to enhance the quality of that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Where was the enhancement for this done?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It was at the FBI laboratories in Quantico, Virginia, in the United States of America.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Finally, I would like for you to look at the last photograph of the video stills which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 222, and again this is a situation where there is no original with this, these are just copies. Is the original of this one also with Mr. Tabbush?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, can you explain what is depicted in this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is probably one of the last scenes which you can see at 15.42. You can see the road here with the buses. What is important, if you can focus on this area on the right-hand side of the road, we have a traffic sign here, there's an electrical or telephone post here, and then in this area, you can see very distinctive top part of the tree right behind the buses (indicated).

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is there also a small shed which is depicted in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. It's just next to the traffic sign on the right. You can see a little bit white.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Does there appear to be something in front of the shed?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It appears to be a truck or the trolley of the truck. You can see the wheels here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And, Mr. Dzuro, were all of these video stills that we have just viewed, numbers 216 to 222, were all of these made from the videotape which has been marked as Defence Exhibit 2?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would tender these video stills as Prosecutor's Exhibits 215 through 222.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Dzuro, at some point in time, did you travel back to Vukovar in order to assist in your determination of what locations and objects were depicted on the videotape?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When was this?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It was the beginning of February 1998.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At that time, did you take the video stills with you when you went to Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did, and also I took the map.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What did you do when you arrived in Vukovar to try to locate some of these locations?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: First I travelled to the centre of Vukovar, and from there, I travelled south towards Negoslavci on the road, and I inspected the buildings on the right side, on the left side of the road.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: During the course of travelling from the centre of Vukovar to Negoslavci, were you able to -- before I ask that, let me rephrase this. Did you only go as far as Negoslavci, or did you continue to other locations as well?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I travelled first to Negoslavci and then I continued to Orolik and Sidski Banovci on the same road.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: During this travel between the centre of Vukovar and Sidski Banovci, were you able to find the various locations which are shown on the videotape?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Have you had an opportunity to match up the times and locations depicted on the videotape with the actual locations on a map?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please now look at the map of the Vukovar-Negoslavci area, which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 223? Again, Mr. Dzuro, I would ask, when you receive this, if you can display this on the ELMO as well? Mr. Dzuro, have you seen this map before?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I have.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Have you already identified certain locations on this map and indicated what those locations are?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I have. Actually, this is just a part of the map which I used because it shows all the locations which were important for my investigation, and I photocopied that map and marked various locations on this map.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, what I would like to do is show you portions of the videotape which is marked as Defence Exhibit 2, and if you would be able perhaps to indicate on the ELMO what is being depicted? I understand that it's impossible to view the videotape and the map at the same time, so what we will do is we will show you a portion of the videotape, and then if you can just take the marker and trace on the map where we have seen, and perhaps if this can be shifted down just a little bit where you are covering -- well, I think that's about as far as -- that's good. Where it goes up to right at the centre of Vukovar. At this time, then, I would ask that the videotape, Defence Exhibit 2, be displayed starting at 15.17, please? Your Honours, I apologise for the delay, but I'm afraid it's necessary to make his testimony clear to go through in order so ... (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I think if we can go back a little bit to 15.17, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I don't have a signal on the monitor. Fine. Freeze the tape now, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I think we have to go through the segment perhaps because it requires a switch over to the ELMO, if that's correct, which takes a moment of time. Very well. We can do that. All right. If you can explain where we have seen up until this point?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The vehicle left VELEPROMET, which is located here, and drove north toward the centre of Vukovar, and I left -- I asked for freezing of the tape somewhere in this area (indicated). The road actually goes downhill. This is the top, this crossing, and it goes downhill toward the centre of Vukovar. So now we are in that curve here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you can move the map down just a little bit? I think that's fine there now. At that point, where the vehicle is travelling, it is travelling in a northerly direction; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. It travels in a north direction towards the centre of Vukovar.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now if we can continue with the videotape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it now, please. A bit backward? Stop. Stop it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And, again, if you can refer on the map to where this is located, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is the Orthodox church which is marked on the map here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is the point where it is stopped, is right before the Orthodox church; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. Orthodox church will be on the right side, which will be on the corner of the building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If we can continue the video now? On the map, just for clarity purposes, the Orthodox church is marked by the red dot, is that correct, right at the very top before the map is discontinued?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If you can continue the video now, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would ask that the video be moved ahead to 15.30, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, is it fair to say that in the period between 15.20 and 15.30 that the group is in the centre of Vukovar, which is just right off of the area that is depicted on this map?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And then if we can start again at 15.30 as the vehicle is leaving the centre of Vukovar, and at that point, if you can trace the route as it returns back south? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If we can go back to the map?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Again, the Orthodox church, now it's on the left side of the road because the car is travelling in the south direction towards Negoslavci, so, yes, by the same church, the red spot on the map.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If we can continue the tape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it now, please? A little bit back? That's it. Stop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If we can go to the map, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The car is moving on that road south, and the chapel you can see on the left side is right here by the crossing. You see the crossing is here and the chapel is right here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The chapel is depicted on the map again by a small red dot; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If we can continue the video now, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it, please. May I continue?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes, please, if you would?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The camera is looking actually in this direction towards the street, and the car, the Red Cross car, is parked on the corner of this intersection.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If we can continue the video now, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it now, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, if you can indicate where that is on the map, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is the tree I showed previously on the still. This tree is right here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The mulberry tree, being the tree with what appears to be the hole in it; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Again, if you can refer to the map, and then -- or perhaps I guess the video can start back again at this point, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it. Backward, please. This is the roof of the house I was referring previously on the still I took from the video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Before we get to that, Mr. Dzuro, if we can, perhaps if we can go back right to the point where it ends at 15.36 and freeze it there, the video? A little further on forward, please? I think it goes past the tree there. At that point, perhaps if we can just freeze it there? Now, this is very similar to one of the video stills that has already been presented to the court; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In this place which is depicted at 15.36, can you point that out exactly where it is on the map, where we're seeing the video segment end at 15.36?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I marked it on the map and it is here (indicated).

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: After we see the scene which has a time indication of 15.36, at that point, are there any houses between that location and Negoslavci?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, there are no houses on the road, on the right or left side of the road, there are no houses.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So Negoslavci is the next village that one comes to after leaving Vukovar; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If you continue on the same road, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which direction is Negoslavci from Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: They're almost directly south.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, the next segment, after the one with the time indication of 15.36, I believe shows a time of 15.42; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, if we can show the clip, 15.42, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it, please? A little bit back. More than that. More. A little bit more. Okay. That's okay.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is shown happening in this clip from 15.42? What do we see occurring?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: As you can see, the buses coming from Vukovar south on the road, between Vukovar and Negoslavci --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just to make that absolutely clear. They're coming from the direction of Vukovar travelling south?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Were you able to determine the location where this was filmed?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I was.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Would you please indicate on the map exactly where you determined the segment from 15.42 to have been filmed?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It's here on the map (indicated). I marked it on the map. I put a label toward that location depicted as 15.42.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How did you make this determination? Perhaps if we can go back to the video, it might be helpful.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Please. There is a --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You're not going to be able to point to it, you're just going to have to describe it, I'm afraid, or perhaps if it would be helpful for you to use the video still at this point and maybe to point out certain things.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If I may, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I believe the appropriate video still which matches the photograph, or the part of the video we're seeing, is Prosecutor's Exhibit 222. Again, Mr. Dzuro, my question to you is: What characteristics did you look at which helped you to determine that the location that we see in the video at 15.42 is, in fact, the spot that you have marked on the map?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: First I will refer to the previous stills. The building which is on the right side of the road travelling from Vukovar to Negoslavci, which is the brick building with the gable facing the road and the trees in front of it, and then also here, the electric post, the tree above the buses, the traffic sign in that location, and the white building, the building is like a shed (indicated).

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Again, perhaps if we can look at Prosecutor's Exhibit 217, and you just made reference to the house with the gable facing the front. If you can perhaps show this on the ELMO and explain what you are talking about there with the pointer? Again, if you can point to this, please, and talk about the characteristics here that helped you to identify the location?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's the roof of the building with the gable facing the road and the tree is very close to the building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In trying to locate this spot, did you go to any other locations other than just in Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I continued driving to Negoslavci, Orolik, and Sidski Banovci, and the same thing as I did in Vukovar, inspected both right and left side of the road and trying to locate some other building and -- not only the building but the trees, the telephone, electric posts, which will show me that the location could be there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In doing this, in going to Negoslavci and Orolik and up and down this road between Vukovar, did you find any other location where all of these combination of factors were present?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, I didn't find any. There is none.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In fact, as you went through Negoslavci, what did you find to be different or distinctive to Negoslavci that we do not see in this film segment?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It will be possible to see it on the video that I made, but in general terms, in the area on the right and left side of the road, there is a distinctive ditch with reinforced bridges for the driveways. Also, the buildings are much further down, set much further down from the road, and then there were trees in a big part of Negoslavci, evergreen trees mixed with the leaf trees, which also doesn't appear on this picture, electric lines which are connected to the roofs of the buildings which again, on this building, you can't see that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, let me ask you: If one is travelling south from Vukovar in the direction of Negoslavci at the location depicted at 15.36, is it possible to get to the location depicted at 15.42 without making any stops, turns, or changes in direction?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, it's impossible.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In fact, it requires a complete reversal of direction, a 180-degree turn, does it not?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honours, it's 5.00 now. We do have a fair amount of testimony still left, so perhaps this would be a good breaking point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes. All right. So we adjourn now and reconvene tomorrow at 10.15.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
